name: Dodge Durango SRT
h1: Dodge Durango SRT: performance, engines and what owners say

nhtsa.note: NHTSA files the Durango SRT 392 and SRT Hellcat under Durango, so these counts are every Durango of these years.

gens.tag: 475 hp 392 SRT for 2018–2024; 710 hp Hellcat for 2021 and 2023–2025.

weight.note: maker estimate, 2018; the 2023 spec sheet lists 5,378 lb

variants.name: Durango SRT 392 AlcHEMI

price.note: 2024, plus $1,595 destination (Motor1); Dodge priced it $3,595 over the SRT 392 Premium

variants.what: Up to 1,000 built: satin black forged 20-inch wheels, yellow Brembo calipers, honeycomb stripes, 392 seat embroidery.

variants.name: Durango SRT Hellcat
variants.what: Uses the supercharged 6.2 Hellcat engine instead of the 392, with the heavier-duty 8HP95 automatic; skipped 2022.

variants.name: Durango SRT Hellcat Hammerhead

price.note: 2025, plus $1,595 destination; every 2025 Hellcat was a Last Call special edition

variants.what: Last Call edition: Night Moves blue paint, Hammerhead Grey leather, satin black hood, Satin Carbon wheels, black Brembos.

392.name: 392 HEMI 6.4
facts: 475 hp at 6,000 rpm, 470 lb-ft at 4,300 rpm (Durango SRT)
Pushrod, 16 valves, sodium-filled exhaust and hollow-stem intake valves
Cast-iron block with cross-bolted mains, aluminum hemi heads, 10.9:1 compression

issues.x: Owners report a tick from failed roller lifters that then wear the camshaft. SlashGear links most cases to the cylinder-deactivation (MDS) lifters and low oil flow.
issues.fix: Replacing the lifters and camshaft fixes it; on-time oil changes with the right oil help prevent it.

issues.t: No engine recall on the Durango
issues.x: NHTSA lists no recall for the 6.4 engine on 2018–2024 Durangos. The recalls that hit SRT models are for other parts, such as the rear spoiler.

hellcat.name: Hellcat 6.2 supercharged HEMI
facts: 710 hp at 6,100 rpm, 645 lb-ft (Durango SRT Hellcat)
2.38-liter twin-screw, up to 11.6 psi, dual water-to-air intercoolers
Cast-iron block, forged steel crank, forged pistons, powder-forged rods; 9.5:1 compression

issues.x: Worn supercharger front bearings cause noise and can damage the rotors and the drive coupler pins, an enthusiast magazine reports.
issues.fix: Replacing the four front bearings fixes nearly all of the noise.

issues.t: No engine recall on the Durango
issues.x: NHTSA lists no recall for the Hellcat engine on 2021–2025 Durangos.
